title: Countertop Shelf with Pull-Out Basket – Double the Space on the Same Counter
descriptionHtml:
The counter ran out of room three appliances ago

The coffee maker, the breakfast things and the jars are crowded onto the same half meter. The only thing growing in the kitchen is the pile.

The shelf that creates another level

A wooden top to put things on – and under it a metal basket on rails that you pull out like a drawer. What was in the way gets its own place, without you drilling or rebuilding anything.

Features

  • Twice the counter space – put things on top, store underneath
  • The basket slides out like a drawer – you see everything without lifting anything off
  • Stands firmly on its own – no drilling, no holes in the wall
  • Wood and black metal – looks like furniture, not like a pallet crate

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
